name: Cleanup - inactive listings
description: Nightly 00:12: check listings in BigQuery (4zida HEAD, CityExpert all search pages, age for Nekretnine.rs/Halo) → backup table → recreate the table without inactive listings. Aborts if >50% look dead.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { query: "SELECT id, ANY_VALUE(url) AS url, ANY_VALUE(izvor) AS izvor, DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE('Europe/Belgrade'), DATE(MIN(upisano), 'Europe/Belgrade'), DAY) AS starost FROM `stan-hunter.stan_hunter.listings` WHERE url IS NOT NULL AND url != '' AND NOT STARTS_WITH(izvor, 'fb') GROUP BY id", useLegacySql: false, location: 'EU', timeoutMs: 30000, maxResults: 5000 } }}
